title: Session middleware null-pointers when cookie domain mismatch occurs
symptom: Requests intermittently returned 500 with TypeError Cannot read properties of undefined reading id when users hit /api/me shortly after the cookie domain was changed in config.
root_cause: The session loader returned undefined when the cookie domain mismatched the request host, and the auth middleware proceeded to dereference req.session.user.id without a null check.
fix: auth.js now treats req.session === undefined as unauthenticated and short-circuits to 401. session.js was also updated to log a warning when the cookie domain check fails so the upstream cause is observable.
impact: All endpoints behind requireAuth. User-visible: brief 500s on /api/me, /api/orders, /api/notifications. No data loss.
